findingDetails.title: The containment promise diverges at three story levels: the comments promise, the inline code advises, the runner preserves
findingDetails.evidence: level 1: the YAML comments, copied x16 per auto variant across four trees, promise revert + containment_violation event + fail the iteration fail-closed (deep-review-auto.yaml:1515-1519); level 2: the YAML inline code at those sites ships console.error advisory plus process.exit(dispatchExit) (:1528-1538); level 3: the runner, the actual enforcement surface, defaults containmentMode to preserve (fanout-run.cjs:2984, the chain CLI override then parsed config then the literal), which detects, records, and quarantines a copy under the lineage (write-containment.ts:19, :318) but does not revert and does not fail; restore is the opt-in (:2452 commentary) and the second-writer latch locks preserve for good (:3424); the remediation contract (unrecoverable as the one outcome that is not a remedy :73-83, the quarantine-time git-blob hash :275, recoveryHint :256-266) describes machinery the default mode does not exercise; the review and research variants are copy-identical at the census (16/4/4/4) so the drift risk is inter-surface, not inter-loop
findingDetails.recommendation: One authority statement in the library naming which surface owns enforcement and what the default mode actually does, with the YAML comments shortened to cite it; alternatively flip the default to restore and let the second-writer latch be the only preserve path
findingDetails.scopeProof: Angle 9 duplicated-rules question, the spec's own example (the inline containment blocks beside the runner's); all five surfaces census-counted; extends F004 (the comment-promise) to the architecture level with the ownership question newly identified — recorded as new, not a refinement

findingDetails.title: The mechanical post-dispatch gate is promised to both leaves but invoked by neither confirm-variant surface
findingDetails.evidence: the verify-iteration.cjs invocation census: review-auto x1, review-confirm x0; both variants render the same prompt pack whose OUTPUT CONTRACT tells the dispatched leaf the gate (verify-iteration.cjs --loop-type review --artifact-dir <lineage> --iteration N) exits 0 only when all three artifacts hold (pack-001:113 = pack-002:113 = pack-004:113); the confirm-variant count of zero means its post-dispatch validation either runs under a different mechanism (prose delegation to the interactive operator) or does not invoke the binary; the auto-variant leaf is mechanically gated (this lane's iterations 1-3 each passed it) while the confirm-variant leaf's equivalent claims are self-certified; this is the validation-leg instance of the confirm-variant divergence pattern already noted in F008
findingDetails.recommendation: Either invoke the gate in the confirm variant post-dispatch step (the cheapest parity) or add one sentence to the pack STATE block saying that in :confirm runs the gate is the operator responsibility, so the leaf self-understanding matches who actually checks it
findingDetails.scopeProof: Angle 9 validator-multiplicity leg; the gate promised in the shared pack, invoked in exactly one of the two variant surfaces; in-scope trees
